blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Existing video language models encode sampled RGB frames independently, so a long video must either exhaust the token budget or drop the changes between sampled frames. Codec-aware front-ends read the motion vectors and residuals that encoding already produced, but in their deployed form each predictive frame is still tokenized on its own: the tokens are a function of the current primitives, not of a carried reference. We argue that a more natural function is of both—the current primitives and a carried reference. A clip and its time reversal share the same frames and differ only in the order of changes—an axis that symmetric pooling discards by construction, and that is non-empty in the frozen vision features VideoLMs actually use—and the codec recurrence already composes those changes in order against a reference state. We introduce RESUME, a stateful codec representation: an anchor I-frame initializes a compact latent state, each subsequent predictive frame is consumed as an update to that state, and a shared readout exposes VideoLM-compatible tokens from the accumulated state. Codec prediction is thereby kept at the representation level and handed to the language model as a trajectory, not as a set of independent token groups. At the same per-predictive-frame token budget as prior codec-aware methods, a predictive frame enters the language model as a readout of what the front-end already knows, not as an encoding of the current primitives alone. Across ten benchmarks, the gains concentrate on temporal reasoning: on all three temporal benchmarks RESUME improves over both the RGB-frame baseline LLaVA-Video-7B (by 2.8 2.8 , 5.1 5.1 , and 3.9 3.9 points on TempCompass, TOMATO, and MVBench) and the codec-based baseline CoPE-7B, while staying competitive on general and long-form QA. Frozen-transition tests further show anchor dependence, order sensitivity, and useful rollout behavior beyond the training horizon.
blocks.zh: 现有的视频语言模型独立地将RGB帧样本编码,因此长视频要么必须耗尽符号预算,要么在样本帧之间降低变化. 代码意识前端读取已经产生的运动向量和残余物,但以它们所部署的形式,每个预测框仍然单独表示: 符号是当前原始物的一种函数,而不是一个带载的参考物. 我们主张,更自然的功能是既包括目前的原始人,又包括一个参考物。 一个剪辑及其时间反转共享相同的帧, 并且只在变化的顺序上有所不同—— 一个通过构造对称的集合丢弃物的轴, 而在冷冻的视觉特性中是非空的 LM 实际使用—— 并且代码重现已经根据参考状态来构成这些变化 。 我们引入了RESUME,一种状态的编码表示:一个主机I-frame初始化了一个紧凑的潜伏状态,每个后续的预测框被消耗作为该状态的更新,一个共享的读出会暴露出来自累积状态的VideoLM兼容符号. 因此,编码预测被保留在代表级别上,并交给语言模型作为轨迹,而不是作为一组独立的符号组. 在与之前的解码-意识方法相同的按预测框符号预算中,一个预测框作为读取前端已经知道的事物而进入语言模型,而不是仅仅作为当前原始事物的编码. 在10个基准中,成果集中在时间推理上:在所有3个时间基准上,RESUME都比RGB-框架基线LLaVA-Video-7B(比TempCompass、TOMATO和MV Bench的2.82.8、5.1.5.1和3.9点)和基于编码的基线CPE-7B有所改进,同时在一般和长式质量保证上保持竞争力。 冻结-过渡测试进一步显示锚的依赖性,订单敏感性,以及超出训练视野的有用的展开行为.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Video language models encode visual observations so that a language model can reason about actions, event order, and cross-frame relations. Recent systems improve video question answering through stronger vision backbones, larger instruction corpora, and longer context windows ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2024c ) . Their standard abstraction, however, remains a collection of independently encoded RGB snapshots.
blocks.zh: 视频语言模型将视觉观测编码,这样一个语言模型就可以对动作,事件顺序,和跨帧关系进行推理. 近期的系统通过更强大的视觉主干线,更大的指令化公司(corpora)和更长的上下文窗口(Zhang等人,2023年;Zhang等人,2024年c )来改进视频问答. 然而,他们的标准抽象仍然是独立编码的RGB快照的集合.

blocks.en: Dense RGB sampling preserves transient actions and state changes but repeatedly pays the full image-encoding and token cost. Sparse keyframe sampling is cheaper but discards the changes between sampled frames; the central limitation is therefore representational rather than a lack of context length.
blocks.zh: Dense RGB采样保存了瞬态动作和状态变化,但反复支付全部图像编码和符号成本. Sparse键框采样成本较低,但放弃了被采样框之间的变化;因此,中心限制是代表性的,而不是缺少上下文长度.

blocks.en: The question is representational: what must a video representation preserve for temporal questions to be answerable? A clip and its time reversal contain the same frames but differ in the order of changes, so symmetric pooling is invariant to reversal by construction. A training-free probe study on frozen vision encoders confirms that static pooling is exactly invariant, while an order-sensitive probe flips on 75 75 – 86 % 86\% of reversed clips (Figure 3 ). Temporal order is therefore a distinct information axis discarded by symmetric aggregation and preserved by a state updated in sequence.
blocks.zh: 问题是代表性:视频代表性必须保存什么才能回答时间问题? 片段及其时间反转包含相同的帧,但变化的顺序不同,因此对称的集合因构造而变异于反转. 一项关于冷冻视觉编码器的无训练探测器研究证实静态集合完全不常态,而一个对命令敏感的探测器则在75 75 — 86 % 86 — 的反转片段上翻转(图3). 因此,时间顺序是一个独特的信息轴,被对称聚合所抛弃,并被序列更新的状态所保留.

blocks.en: Video codecs already exploit temporal redundancy by storing an independently coded I-frame and describing each predictive frame with motion vectors and residuals ( Le Gall, 1991 ; Wiegand et al., 2003 ) . Compressed-domain recognition established that these primitives carry usable dynamics ( Wu et al., 2018 ; Wang et al., 2021 ; Das Biswas et al., 2025 ) , and codec-aware VideoLMs such as Video-LaVIT ( Jin et al., 2024 ) , EMA ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) , and CoPE-VideoLM ( Sarkar et al., 2026 ) use them to cover more timestamps at lower visual-token cost. However, their deployed encoders emit an independent token group for each predictive frame, leaving reference dependence and temporal composition to language-model attention.
blocks.zh: 视频编解码器已经利用时间冗余,储存了一个独立的编码I-框架,并描述每个带有运动载体和残余物的预测框架(Le Gall,1991年;Wiegand等人,2003年)。 压缩域识别确定这些原始生物携带可用的动态(Wu等人,2018年;Wang等人,2021年;Das Biswas等人,2025年),以及像Video-LaVIT这样的具有编码意识的视频LM. (Jin等人,2024年),EMA (Zhao等人,2025年),和CoPE-VideoLM(Sarkar等人,2026年)使用它们以较低的视觉脚本成本支付更多的时间戳. 然而,它们部署的编码器为每个预测框架发出一个独立的符号组,将参考依赖和时间组成留给语言模型关注.

(1) A predictive frame is a function of a reference state . Three consequences follow. First, reference dependence : the same rightward motion field means “the ball moves right” against one reference and “the person shifts right” against another, so ( τ t , δ t ) (\tau_{t},\delta_{t}) alone does not determine the updated content. Second, compositionality : video events are typically accumulations of small changes, which become an event only when applied in sequence to a state that keeps changing. Third, path dependence : the outcome depends on the order in which updates are applied, not on the set of updates. These are not properties imposed on the data; they are what the recurrence already computes. They are preserved by construction in a state that is updated in sequence, and left to be reconstructed by language-model attention when each predictive frame is tokenized independently. Prior codec-aware work is not unaware of the recurrence: CoPE-VideoLM emulates one warping step in feature space during pre-training. But that step reads its reference from a decoded RGB frame rather than from a carried state, and it is removed before the encoder meets the language model, so nothing accumulates and nothing survives into inference.

blocks.en: The question is therefore not how to represent each predictive frame with fewer tokens, but how a VideoLM front-end can keep the codec’s own predictive structure at the representation level, from one anchor to the next, rather than leaving it for language-model attention to reconstruct.
blocks.zh: 因此,问题不在于如何用更少的符号来表示每个预测框架,而在于一个视频LM前端如何将编码器自身的预测结构从一个锚到另一个锚,而不是留给语言模型关注重建.

blocks.en: We introduce RESUME , a stateful codec representation that carries a latent state across an anchor’s predictive frames instead of tokenizing each one independently (Figure 1 ). Each anchor I-frame initializes a compact latent state, subsequent motion-residual observations update that state causally, and a shared readout exposes VideoLM-compatible tokens from the accumulated state. The state is reset at the next anchor, while frozen vision features provide its initial condition and supervision space. Unlike independent tokenization, RESUME learns previous state + current primitive → \to next state at the same per-predictive-frame token budget.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了 ResUME , 一种状态的编码代表,它包含着潜伏状态,跨越一个锚的预测框架,而不是独立地标出每个锚(图1 ) 。 每个主机I-frame初始化了一个紧凑的潜伏状态,随后的动静观测更新了该状态的因果状态,共享的读出会从累积状态中暴露出VideoLM兼容的符号. 状态被重置在下一锚,而冷冻的视觉特征则提供了初始状态和监督空间. 与独立符号化不同,RESUME以相同的预测框架符号预算来学习前态+当前原始 →\to下一态.

Figure 1: Three ways to turn a group of pictures into visual tokens.
(a) Dense RGB encoding treats every frame as a full image.
(b) Deployed codec-aware tokenization reads motion vectors and residuals, but emits an independent token group per predictive frame; temporal dependence is left to language-model attention.
(c) RESUME initializes a compact latent state from the anchor I-frame and updates that same state with each codec observation; the tokens of a predictive frame are a readout of the accumulated state.
The two codec columns tokenize each predictive frame; only (c) maintains a reference-dependent state in the visual front-end.

blocks.en: Training has two stages. Stage 1 learns the transition from multi-step ordered rollouts, supervising both intermediate readouts and their changes. Stage 2 attaches the frozen transition to a VideoLM, packs the state readouts with each I-frame token group, and trains the language model to use them through a dedicated projector.
blocks.zh: 培训分为两个阶段。 第一阶段从多步骤有序推出学习过渡,监督中间读出及其变化。 第2阶段将冻结的过渡附加到一个VideoLM中,将状态读取与每个I-frame符号组打包,并训练语言模型通过专用投影仪使用.

blocks.en: The experiments support both the representation-level claim and its downstream effect. In a training-free probe study, the order-sensitive probe flips on 75 75 – 86 % 86\% of reversed clips, while static pooling is exactly invariant and order-agnostic difference statistics move only through endpoint displacement. On the frozen transition, applying the same updates to different anchors preserves anchor-dependent context, the correct update order wins on 65 % 65\% of videos, and the carried state is more accurate than a memoryless control on 75 % 75\% and 68 % 68\% of videos at rollout horizons of 8 8 and 16 16 steps. With the language model, RESUME improves over LLaVA-Video-7B by 2.8 2.8 , 5.1 5.1 , and 3.9 3.9 points on TempCompass, TOMATO, and MVBench, and improves over CoPE-7B by 0.5 0.5 , 1.7 1.7 , and 0.6 0.6 points, respectively, while using the same per-predictive-frame readout budget. These results connect the information hierarchy to the final VideoLM interface: preserving ordered codec changes in a carried state improves the benchmarks that require temporal evolution.
blocks.zh: 实验证明陈述层次的索赔及其下游影响。 在一项无培训探测器研究中,对命令敏感的探测器翻转了75 75 — — 86 % 86 — — 的反向剪辑,而静态集合则完全不常见,命令不可知的差数统计只通过端点移位移动. 在冻结的过渡中,将相同的更新应用到不同的主播上,保留了主播依赖的上下文,正确的更新命令在65%的65QQ视频上胜出,而携带的状态比在8步和16步的推出地平线对75%的75QQ和68%的68QQ视频进行无记忆控制更准确. 使用语言模型,RESUME在TempCompass,TOMATO和MV Bench上比LLaVA-Video-7B改进了2.8 2.8, 5.1 5.1和3.9分,比CPE-7B改进了0.5 0.5,1.7 1.7 0.6分,同时采用了相同的按预测框架阅读的预算. 这些结果将信息层次与最终的VideoLM接口连接起来:在承载状态中保存有序的编码更改可以改善需要时间演化的基准.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: 1. Problem formulation. We formulate codec-aware video representation as a causal latent state transition between successive anchors. This formulation identifies reference dependence, compositionality, and path dependence as the properties that independent predictive-frame tokenization leaves to language-model attention to reconstruct. 2. Stateful codec representation. We instantiate this formulation with RESUME: an anchor I-frame initializes a compact latent state, motion vectors and residuals are fused into one codec observation, and a causal transition carries the state across predictive frames. The resulting state encoder contains approximately 21 21 M parameters, while a shared readout exposes VideoLM-compatible tokens at the same per-predictive-frame budget as prior codec-aware methods. 3. Empirical evidence. Training-free probes on frozen vision encoders show that temporal order is a non-empty information axis discarded by symmetric aggregation (Figure 3 ). Frozen-transition experiments verify anchor dependence, order sensitivity, and useful rollout behavior beyond the training horizon (Figure 4 ). On all three temporal benchmarks, RESUME improves over both the RGB-frame baseline LLaVA-Video-7B (by 2.8 2.8 , 5.1 5.1 , and 3.9 3.9 points) and the codec-based baseline CoPE-7B, while staying competitive on general and long-form QA.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是: 1. 问题的表述。 我们制作有解码意识的视频,作为连续主播之间的因果潜在状态过渡. 这种提法将参考依赖性,组成性和路径依赖性确定为独立预测框示意化留给语言模型关注重建的属性. 2. 国家编码代表。 我们用RESUME即时化这种配方:一个锚I-框架将一个紧凑的潜伏状态初始化,运动向量和残余物被融合成一个编码观测,一个因果过渡将状态带过预测框架. 由此形成的状态编码器包含约21个21 M参数,而共享的读出则暴露出VideoLM-兼容的代币,在与先前的编码意识方法相同的按预测框架预算. 3. 经验证据。 关于冷冻视觉编码器的无培训探测器显示,时间顺序是一个非空信息轴,被对称聚合所抛弃(图3 ). 冷冻-过渡实验验证锚的依赖性,命令敏感度,以及超出训练视野的有用的展开行为(图4 ). 在所有三个时间基准上,RESUME都改进了RGB-框架基线LLaVA-Video-7B(增加了2.82.8分,5.1分,3.9分)和基于编码的基线CPE-7B,同时在一般和长式质量保证上保持竞争力。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Frame-based VideoLMs and post-hoc compression
blocks.zh: 2.1 基于框架的视频LM和后热压缩

blocks.en: VideoLMs extend image VLMs by supplying visual tokens at multiple timestamps. Video-LLaMA ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) , VideoChat2 ( Li et al., 2023b ) , VideoLLaMA2 ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) , LLaVA-NeXT-Video ( Liu et al., 2024a ) , and LLaVA-Video ( Zhang et al., 2024c ) established the standard workflow: sample RGB frames, tokenize each independently, and let a temporal module or the language model reason over the sequence. Subsequent work reduces the resulting token count by pooling, merging, pruning, or learnable resampling ( Li et al., 2023a ; Yao et al., 2024 ; Bolya et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024a ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Tao et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ) . These compressions are post-hoc: they operate after a dense RGB representation has been produced, so the encoding cost is already paid and each retained frame remains an independent observation.
blocks.zh: 视频 LMS通过在多个时间戳上提供视觉符号来扩展图像VLM. Video-LLaMA(张等,2023年),VideoChat2(李等,2023年b),VideoLLLAMA2(程等,2024年),LLaVA-NEXT-Video (Liu et al., 2024a),和LLaVA-Video(Zhang et al., 2024c)建立了标准的工作流程:样本RGB帧,分别独立标注,让一个时空模块或语言模型理由凌驾于序列之上. 随后的工作通过集合、合并、挤兑或可学习的再取样,减少由此产生的符号计数(Li等人,2023a); Yao等人,2024年;Bolya等人,2023年;Chen等人,2024年a;Yang等人,2024年;Tao等人,2025年;Sun等人,2025年). 这些压缩是Hoc后:它们在产生密集的RGB表示后运行,因此编码成本已经支付,每个保留框架仍然是独立的观察.

blocks.en: 2.2 Codec primitives as VideoLM input
blocks.zh: 2.2 作为视频LM输入的编码原始数据

blocks.en: Compressed-domain recognition showed that I-frames, motion vectors, and residuals carry usable dynamics without decoding most frames ( Wu et al., 2018 ; Wang et al., 2021 ; Das Biswas et al., 2025 ) . Video-LaVIT ( Jin et al., 2024 ) discretizes motion into language-like tokens but largely discards residuals; EMA ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) aggregates an I-frame and motion into a fixed-length GOP summary, collapsing P-frame order. A further group uses codec signals as a selection cue—keeping salient patches or refreshing a cache according to bitstream activity—which reduces what is encoded without changing what a predictive frame’s representation is a function of ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Tang et al., 2026 ; An et al., 2026 ) . AdaCodec ( Hou et al., 2026 ) regresses codec-derived tokens onto a frozen teacher and drops the auxiliary head before language-model training.
blocks.zh: 压缩域识别显示,I-frames,运动矢量,和残基携带可用的动力学而不解码大多数帧(Wu等人,2018年;Wang等人,2021年;Das Biswas等人,2025年). 视频LaVIT (Jin等人,2024年) 将运动磁盘化为类似语言的符号,但基本上丢弃残余物;EMA (Zhao等人,2025年) 将一个I帧集合起来,并运动成一个固定长度的GOP摘要,崩溃的P帧顺序. 另一组使用编码信号作为选择提示——根据位流活动保持突出的补丁或刷新缓存——减少编码内容而不改变预测框的表示功能(Yang等人,2026年;Tang等人,2026年;An等人,2026年)。 阿达科迪奇 (Hou等人,2026年) 将代码衍生的代币退到冷冻的老师身上,并在语言模型训练前放下辅助头.

blocks.en: CoPE-VideoLM ( Sarkar et al., 2026 ) encodes motion vectors and residuals into compact per-predictive-frame tokens. Its pre-training emulates a feature-space warping step using a reference re-measured from decoded RGB, but the auxiliary modules are removed before VideoLM integration. At inference, each predictive-frame token group depends on the current primitives rather than a carried visual state; temporal order is retained in the token sequence.
blocks.zh: CPE-视频LM (Sarkar等人,2026年)将运动矢量和残基编码成紧凑的每帧符号. 它的预训模拟了一个功能空间扭曲步骤,使用从解码的RGB中重新测量的参考,但辅助模块在VideoLM集成之前被移除. 推论,每个预测框符号组取决于目前的原始物,而不是一个携带的视觉状态;时间顺序保留在符号序列中.

blocks.en: Codec-driven state propagation also appears outside this interface. Compressed-domain recognition maintains separate motion and residual states without I-frame initialization ( Das Biswas et al., 2025 ) , while video super-resolution propagates hidden states for reconstruction rather than language-model readout. ReMoRa ( Yashima et al., 2026 ) uses a bidirectional I-frame–motion scan with one GOP-level readout and no residual input. RESUME instead combines causal GOP-local updates, I-frame initialization, early motion-residual fusion, and per-predictive-frame readouts at the same token budget as CoPE.
blocks.zh: 代码驱动的状态传播也出现在此接口之外. 压缩域识别保持独立的运动状态和未I帧初始化的剩余状态(Das Biswas等人,2025年),而视频超解则传播隐藏状态用于重建而非语言模型读取. ReMoRa(Yashima等人,2026年)使用双向I-frame-motion扫描,带有一个GOP级读取,没有剩余输入. RESUME转而结合了因果GOP-局部更新,I-帧初始化,早期运动剩余聚变,以及按预测帧读取与CPE相同的预算.

blocks.en: The question above is how a VideoLM front-end can keep the codec’s own predictive structure at the representation level, rather than leaving it for language-model attention to reconstruct. We instantiate that as a transition system (Figure 2 ). The architecture below is one realization; the constraints come from the three properties the codec recurrence already computes: reference dependence, compositionality, and path dependence.

blocks.en: 3.4 Predictions and scope
blocks.zh: 3.4 预测和范围

blocks.en: The formulation makes predictions that isolate carrying state. Keeping the base VideoLM’s sampled frames fixed, and interleaving readouts of the predictive frames between them, should improve temporal, motion, and state-change reasoning over that sampling alone. Applying a fixed ( τ , δ ) (\tau,\delta) to different anchors should change the readout in a content-consistent way (reference dependence); shuffling updates between two anchors should degrade matching, whereas resetting the state before every update is invariant to that perturbation (path dependence). A model trained on short rollouts should extrapolate to longer horizons with error above a per-step re-initialization oracle and below a memoryless control. That curve diagnoses extrapolation of the transition; it is not evidence of a state maintained across a whole video, because inference re-initializes at every anchor.
blocks.zh: 配体的预测会隔离承载状态. 保持Base VideoLM 的采样帧的固定,以及它们之间预测帧的互换读数,应该能改善时间、运动和状态的变化推理,而仅此而已。 应用固定(\\\\,\\\\\\)到不同的主锚上,应该以内容一致的方式改变读取(参考依赖性);在两个主锚之间刷新应降解匹配,而在每次更新都与扰动(路径依赖性)不一致之前重置状态. 受过短期推出培训的模型应推导到较长的视野,其误差高于每步重启动甲骨文,低于无记忆控制。 这种曲线可以推断过渡过程;它不是整个视频中保持状态的证据,因为推论在每个主播上重新启动。

blocks.en: Four boundaries follow. Stage-1 supervision comes from a frozen vision encoder: semantic features define the initial condition and the measurement space, while codec primitives parameterize the transition. The latent state carries no physical annotation, so we call it a codec-conditioned latent state. Efficiency is a property of the codec domain; the claim is the representational structure obtained at the same per-predictive-frame cost. And the recurrence spans the predictive frames between two anchors, not a whole video: an I-frame re-initializes the state. Claims concern the representation of a group of pictures; long-range aggregation remains the language model’s responsibility.
blocks.zh: 四界随顺. 阶段一监督来自一个冷冻的视觉编码器:语义特征定义了初始条件和测量空间,而代码原始参数则将过渡参数化. 潜伏状态没有物理注释 所以我们称之为 密码条件潜伏状态 效率是解码器域的财产;索赔要求是按预计的相同成本获得的代表结构. 而重现跨越两个主播之间的预测帧,而不是一个完整的视频:一个I-frame重现状态. 索赔涉及一组图片的代表;远程汇总仍然是语文模型的责任。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We first report question-answering results across general, temporal, and long-form benchmarks, then examine the information hierarchy and test whether the transition carries state across predictive updates.
blocks.zh: 我们首先报告一般性、时间性和长式基准的问答结果,然后审查信息层次,并测试过渡是否跨越预测性更新。

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluation benchmarks
blocks.zh: 4.1 评价基准

blocks.en: We evaluate the model on ten benchmarks spanning general video question answering, temporal and motion reasoning, and long-form video. General video question answering: Video-MME ( Fu et al., 2024 ) , PerceptionTest ( Pătrăucean et al., 2023 ) , NExT-QA ( Xiao et al., 2021 ) , and ActivityNet-QA ( Yu et al., 2019 ) . Temporal and motion reasoning: TempCompass ( Liu et al., 2024b ) , TOMATO ( Shangguan et al., 2024 ) , and MVBench ( Li et al., 2024b ) . Long-form video: LVBench ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , Video-TT ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , and Video-MMMU ( Hu et al., 2025 ) . Each video uses at most 64 64 I-frames, and each of the four predictive updates per I-frame produces one 8 8 -token readout. ActivityNet-QA is scored by Claude Opus 4.8 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) . Evaluation details and data are described in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 我们以十项基准来评价模型, 包括一般视频问题回答、时间和动作推理以及长式视频。 一般视频问题回答:视频-MME (Fu等人,2024年),Perception. 测试(Pătrăucean等人,2023年),NExT-QA(Xiao等人,2021年),活动网-QA(Yu等人,2019年). 时间和运动推理:Tempops (Liu等人,2024年b),TOMATO (Shanguan等人,2024年b),和MV Bench (Li等人,2024年b). 长式视频:LV Bench(Wang等人,2024年),Video-TT(Zhang等人,2025年),Video-MMU(Hu等人,2025年). 每个视频最多使用64个I-frame,每个I-frame的4个预测更新都产生1个8个8位读取. ActiveNet-QA由克劳德·奥普斯4.8(Anthropic,2026)打入. 附录介绍了评价的细节和数据。

blocks.en: Results. RESUME shows consistent gains on the temporal benchmarks that directly test motion, order, and change. Compared with LLaVA-Video-7B, it improves by 2.8 2.8 , 5.1 5.1 , and 3.9 3.9 points on TempCompass, TOMATO, and MVBench, respectively. Compared with the codec-based CoPE-7B baseline, the corresponding gains are 0.5 0.5 , 1.7 1.7 , and 0.6 0.6 points. The improvements across both RGB-frame and codec-based baselines indicate that the carried state contributes beyond simply increasing temporal coverage: it provides a representation that preserves and accumulates predictive changes before they reach the language model.
blocks.zh: 结果。 RESUME显示,在直接试验运动、秩序和变化的时间基准方面,不断取得进展。 与LLaVA-Video-7B相比,在TemperCompass,TOMATO和MV Bench上分别改进了2.82.8,5.1 5.1和3.9分. 与基于编码的CPE-7B基线相比,相应的增益为0.5 0.5,1.7 1.7,0.6分. 跨 RGB 框架和基于编码的基线的改进表明,所携带的状态不仅有助于增加时间覆盖面:它提供了一种在到达语言模型之前保持和积累预测变化的表示。

blocks.en: On general and long-form video QA the picture is mixed. PerceptionTest and ActivityNet-QA improve over both LLaVA-Video-7B and CoPE-7B; Video-TT and Video-MMMU match CoPE-7B. Video-MME is 1.4 1.4 points below LLaVA-Video-7B and tied with CoPE-7B; LVBench is 3.2 3.2 points below CoPE-7B. Those two cells track the Stage-2 mixture: we fine-tune only on LLaVA-Video-178K, without the academic QA split or the image-alignment data used for the released base, and Video-MME is sensitive to that composition. Taken together, the stateful codec representation is most effective when the benchmark requires reasoning over temporal evolution, at the same per-predictive-frame readout budget.
blocks.zh: 在一般和长式的视频QA上,画面混合. 感觉 测试和活动 Net-QA比LLaVA-Video-7B和CPE-7B都有改进;Video-TT和Video-MMU匹配CPE-7B. 视频-MME在LLaVA-Video-7B下方1.41.4分,并与CPE-7B捆绑;LV Bench在CPE-7B下方3.23.2分. 这两个细胞跟踪Stage-2的混合物:我们只微调LLaVA-Video-178K,没有学术的QA分裂或用于释放基部的图像对齐数据,Video-MME对这个成分很敏感. 总而言之,当基准要求根据预测的阅读预算对时间演变进行推理时,状态编码表述最为有效。

blocks.en: 4.3 Motivation study: the information hierarchy
blocks.zh: 4.3 动机研究:信息层次

blocks.en: The reversal experiment provides a direct separation witness for the information hierarchy. A clip and its time reversal contain exactly the same frames, so any representation that is symmetric over frames must produce the same score. As shown in Figure 3 , static pooling (P0) is exactly reversal-invariant on both SigLIP and Qwen2.5-VL, with score displacement 0.0000 0.0000 . The order-agnostic difference probe (P1) changes only through the net displacement between endpoints, as predicted by the telescoping identity, yielding an argmax flip rate of 0.68 0.68 – 0.71 0.71 . By contrast, the time-weighted order-sensitive probe (P2) flips on 0.75 0.75 – 0.86 0.86 of clips. These results establish that order is a separate, measurable axis in frozen visual features rather than a by-product of static content or net change.
blocks.zh: 反转实验为信息等级提供了直接的分离见证. 片段及其时间反转包含完全相同的帧,因此任何对称超帧的表示必须产生相同的分数. 如图3所示,在SigLIP和Quen2.5-VL上,静态集合(P0)是完全反演的,得分为0.0000.0000. 定序-不可知差探测器(P1)仅通过端点之间的净移位而变化,如远程扫描身份所预测的,得出0.68 0.68 – 0.71 0.71的正弦翻转率. 相比之下,时间加权的订单敏感探测器(P2)在0.75 0.75 – 0.86 0.86的剪辑上翻转. 这些结果确定秩序是冷冻视觉特征中单独的,可测量的轴线,而不是静态内容或净变化的副产品.

blocks.en: The same conclusion holds for the question-based probe. Order-swapped answer pairs are nearly indistinguishable in pooled text space ( cos ≈ 0.98 \cos\approx 0.98 – 0.99 0.99 ), whereas content-different pairs are substantially more separated ( 0.58 0.58 – 0.72 0.72 ). We therefore use QA ranking for the static and net-change buckets, and use the reversal axis to measure order sensitivity. Together, the two views motivate a representation that accumulates changes in sequence instead of reducing a clip to symmetric frame statistics. Full probe definitions and results are described in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 基于问题的探测器也有同样的结论。 排列的答对在集合文本空间(cos 0.98\cos\约0.98 – 0.99 0.99)中几乎无法区分,而内容不同的答对则大为分离(0.58 0.58– 0.72 0.72). 因此,我们对静态和净变化桶使用QA排名,并使用反转轴测量顺序灵敏度. 这两种观点加在一起,促使一种表述方式累积顺序变化,而不是将剪辑缩小为对称框架统计. 附录中介绍了完整的探测定义和结果。

blocks.en: 4.4 Carried state between sampled frames
blocks.zh: 4.4 抽样框架之间的承载状态

blocks.en: To verify whether the frozen transition preserves anchor-dependent and ordered information, we conduct a study on 40 40 videos from Video-MME ( Fu et al., 2024 ) without language-model training; the results are summarized in Figure 4 . We compare readouts with frozen SigLIP features of the corresponding frames and report the median over videos.
blocks.zh: 为了核实冻结的过渡是否保留了依赖主播和订购的信息,我们对没有语言模型培训的Video-MME(Fu等人,2024年)的40个视频进行了研究;结果摘要见图4。 我们比较读取 与冷冻的SigLIP特性 相应的帧 并报告中位数在视频。

blocks.en: To isolate anchor dependence, we apply the same updates to two different anchors. The resulting readouts move 0.79 × 0.79\times as far as the teacher features, while remaining closer to their respective anchors on 97 % 97\% and 86 % 86\% of videos (Figure 4 (a)). The transition therefore preserves anchor-dependent context while incorporating the current codec update.
blocks.zh: 为了隔离锚的依赖性,我们对两个不同的锚进行相同的更新. 结果的读取移动了0.79×0.79\的时间,以教师的特写,同时在97%的视频(图4(a))和86%的视频(图4(a))上与各自的主播保持距离。 因此,过渡保留了依赖锚的上下文,同时纳入了目前的代码更新。

blocks.en: Order sensitivity is examined by comparing correctly ordered and shuffled update sequences (Figure 4 (b)). The carried state produces lower error in the correct order and wins on 65 % 65\% of videos, whereas resetting to the anchor before every update removes order dependence and gives a median error of 0.55 0.55 . To probe behavior beyond the training horizon, we roll the transition forward for longer sequences (Figure 4 (c)). The carried state remains between the true-frame re-initialization lower bound and the memoryless control, and is more accurate than the latter on 75 % 75\% and 68 % 68\% of videos at horizons of 8 8 and 16 16 steps, respectively. These results show that the transition carries useful state beyond the immediate update and remains informative past the training horizon.

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablations
blocks.zh: 4.5 违约

blocks.en: To isolate the contribution of codec-driven state readouts, we construct paired evaluations under a matched I-frame budget. The base input contains at most 64 64 I-frames, and each I-frame’s four predictive updates each produce one 8 8 -token readout, giving 256 256 readouts in total. For each choice of retained I-frames, N I ∈ { 8 , 16 } N_{I}\in\{8,16\} , we compare two inputs built from exactly the same N I N_{I} I-frames: one retains only the corresponding I-frame tokens, while the other augments those tokens with all 256 256 state readouts. Since the I-frame content and sampling are identical within each pair, the performance difference isolates the contribution of the codec-driven state readouts.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: RESUME treats codec prediction as a representation-level state transition rather than a collection of independent predictive-frame token groups. By initializing a codec-conditioned latent state from each I-frame and updating it with fused motion-residual observations, the model preserves reference dependence and ordered change before the information reaches the language model. The experiments support this view: order is measurable in frozen visual features, the carried state responds to both anchors and update order, and the resulting readouts improve temporal reasoning over both RGB-frame and codec-based baselines at a matched per-predictive-frame budget. The state is carried only between successive I-frames: the next I-frame re-initializes it rather than updating it. We therefore do not claim a state held across a whole video; ordered change within a group of pictures is represented in the front-end, and aggregation across groups remains the language model’s responsibility.
blocks.zh: RESUME将编码预测视为代表级状态过渡,而不是独立预测框符号组的集合. 通过从每个I-框架初始化一个有编码条件的潜伏状态,并用引信的运动剩余观测进行更新,该模型保留了参考依赖性,并在信息到达语言模型之前下令更改. 实验支持这种观点:以冷冻的视觉特征可测量到秩序,载体状态既响应锚地,又响应更新顺序,由此产生的读取结果改善了RGB-帧和基于编码的基线在对应的按预测框架预算上的时间推理. 状态只在相继的I-frame之间承载:下一个I-frame重新初始化而不是更新. 因此,我们并不宣称整个视频都有一个状态;一组图片中命令的更改在前端,各组的汇总仍然是语言模型的责任。

blocks.zh: 附录A 培训详情

blocks.en: The frozen vision encoder is SigLIP ( Zhai et al., 2023 ) . The latent state has S = 16 S{=}16 slots of width d z = 512 d_{z}{=}512 , and the readout uses N = 8 N{=}8 tokens. Initialization and readout each use two pre-norm transformer layers. Motion vectors are patchified and embedded by a shared MLP; residuals are embedded by a truncated ResNet-18 ( He et al., 2016 ) whose stride matches the motion grid.

The learning rate follows a cosine schedule: it warms up for 100 100 steps and then decays over 1500 1500 steps to a quarter of the peak, 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} . Training uses 64 64 GPUs at a global batch size of 16384 16384 , in bfloat16. A readout is supervised at every step.

blocks.en: Stage 2 starts from LLaVA-Video-7B ( Zhang et al., 2024c ) and trains on LLaVA-Video-178K, with a context length of 32768 32768 . The projector has the same shape as the multimodal projector but is independently initialized, because I-frame tokens represent absolute appearance and state readouts represent accumulated relative change. The objective is next-token prediction on the assistant text, and visual tokens are masked out of the loss. Optimization uses AdamW with peak learning rate 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} , weight decay 0 0 , and gradient clipping at 1.0 1.0 . The learning rate follows a cosine schedule with a floor of 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} and a warmup ratio of 0.03 0.03 . The global batch size is 128 128 , and training runs for 10000 10000 steps. blocks.en: Appendix B Training data construction
blocks.zh: 附录B 培训数据构建

blocks.en: We build the training data from the videos of LLaVA-Video-178K, pairing each video with its question–answer annotations at training time. Each video is partitioned into at most 64 64 groups, adaptively to its duration so that longer videos yield more groups. Each group is initialized by an RGB anchor and consists of that anchor followed by four predictive updates; the predictive frames are sampled at a fixed stride of about one per second, shortened for very short groups, and we extract the motion vectors and residuals of each relative to the anchor, consistent with the definition of a codec P-frame. I-frames are resized to 384 384 to match the vision-encoder input. At training time the visual content of each group—the I-frame through the vision encoder, the motion vectors and residuals through the state transition—is combined with the question–answer annotation of the corresponding video into a training example.
blocks.zh: 我们从LLaVA-Video-178K的视频中积累培训数据, 每个视频被分成最多64组64组,适应其持续时间,这样更长的视频产生更多的组. 每个组由一个RGB锚地初始化,由该锚地组成,然后是四个预测更新;预测框以大约每秒一个的固定速度进行取样,对非常短的组群进行缩短,我们提取每个组相对于锚地的运动矢量和剩余量,这与编码P框的定义一致. I-frame被调整为384,384,以配合视觉编码器输入. 在培训时,每个小组的视觉内容——通过视觉编码器的I-框架,通过状态过渡的运动矢量和剩余量——与对相应视频的问答结合起来,成为培训的例子。

blocks.en: Video-MME ( Fu et al., 2024 ) contains 900 900 videos and 2,700 2{,}700 multiple-choice questions, spanning six domains and three durations: short (under 2 2 minutes), medium ( 4 4 – 15 15 minutes), and long ( 30 30 – 60 60 minutes). We report it without subtitles.
blocks.zh: Video-MME(Fu等人,2024年)包含900,900个视频和2,700个2{,}700个多重选择问题,跨越6个领域和3个持续时间:短(2分钟以下),中短(4 4 — 1515分钟),长(30 30 — 60分钟). 我们报告时没有字幕

blocks.en: PerceptionTest ( Pătrăucean et al., 2023 ) (val) is a diagnostic suite over memory, abstraction, physics, and semantics. Its questions ask the model to describe, explain, predict, or consider a counterfactual, and are written so that a language prior is not enough to guess the answer.
blocks.zh: 感觉 测试(Pătrăucean et al., 2023)(val)是一个比记忆,抽象,物理,和语义的诊断套房. 它的问题要求模型描述,解释,预测,或考虑一个反事实,并且被写成一个之前的语言不足以猜测答案.

blocks.en: NExT-QA ( Xiao et al., 2021 ) is built from everyday videos and splits its five-way questions into causal (why or how an event happens), temporal (what happens before or after), and descriptive. Causal and temporal questions are the majority.
blocks.zh: NExT-QA(Xiao等人,2021年)从日常视频中构建,将其五向问题分为因果(为何或事件如何发生),时间(事前或事后发生),以及描述. 原因和时间问题占多数。

blocks.en: ActivityNet-QA ( Yu et al., 2019 ) asks open-ended questions about activities in web video, covering motion, objects, and time. Answers are short, and scoring is done by an external language-model judge.
blocks.zh: ActiveNet-QA(Yu等人,2019年)就网络视频中的活动提出开放式问题,涵盖运动,物体,以及时间. 答案很短,评分由外部语言模型法官完成.

blocks.en: TempCompass ( Liu et al., 2024b ) pairs clips that share their static content and differ in one temporal aspect, so a single frame is not enough. The aspects are action, direction, speed, event order, and attribute change, and each is asked in more than one format, including multiple choice, yes/no, and caption matching.
blocks.zh: TempCompass (Liu et al., 2024b) 配对片段,它们分享其静态内容,在一个时间方面有所不同,所以单帧是不够的. 这些方面是动作、方向、速度、事件顺序和属性变化,每个方面都以一个以上的格式要求,包括多重选择、是/否和标题匹配。

blocks.en: TOMATO ( Shangguan et al., 2024 ) contains 1,484 1{,}484 human-annotated questions on 1,417 1{,}417 videos, over action counting, direction, rotation, shape and trend, velocity and frequency, and visual cues. The clips are chosen so that one frame, or the frames in the wrong order, does not determine the answer.
blocks.zh: TOMATO(Shanguan等人, 2024年)包含1,484个人类问题, 片段的选择使得一个帧,或者按错误顺序的帧,不能决定答案.

blocks.en: MVBench ( Li et al., 2024b ) turns static image questions into twenty video tasks that a single frame cannot solve, from perception through to cognition. They include action sequence, movement direction, object interaction, scene transition, counting, and counterfactual inference.
blocks.zh: MV Bench (Li et al., 2024b)将静态图像问题变成一个单帧无法解决的20个视频任务,从感知到认知. 它们包括动作序列,运动方向,物体交互,场景过渡,计数,以及反事实推论.

blocks.en: LVBench ( Wang et al., 2024 ) uses videos of tens of minutes to several hours, with 1,549 1{,}549 four-way questions whose number grows with duration. The questions cover long-range retrieval, tracking of entities and events, and reasoning across segments.
blocks.zh: LV Bench (Wang et al., 2024)使用数十分钟到数小时的视频,其中1,549 1{,}549个四向问题,其数量随时间长而增加. 这些问题包括远程检索、跟踪实体和活动以及各部门之间的推理。

blocks.en: Video-TT ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) uses 1,000 1{,}000 short videos. Each has one open question and four adversarial follow-ups, separating a failure of frame sampling from a failure to follow the visual or narrative content.
blocks.zh: Video-TT(张等,2025)使用1000 1{,}000短视频. 每一个都有一个未决问题和四个对抗性的后续,将帧抽样的失败与没有跟踪视觉或叙事内容的失败区分开来.

blocks.en: Video-MMMU ( Hu et al., 2025 ) uses 300 300 instructional videos and 900 900 questions across six disciplines. Each video is paired with questions at three stages of acquiring knowledge: perception, comprehension, and adaptation of what was learned to a new case.
blocks.zh: 视频 MMMU (Hu等人,2025年)使用300300个教学视频和900900个问题,跨越6个学科. 每段录像都附有三个阶段的问题,即了解、理解和适应新情况。

blocks.en: Appendix D Evaluation data construction
blocks.zh: 附录D 评价数据构建

blocks.en: We convert the raw videos of each evaluation benchmark into the same codec representation used at training time: an RGB anchor together with the motion vectors and residuals of its subsequent predictive frames. So that frame-indexed sampling is deterministic and reproducible, we first re-encode every video to a fixed structure of 30 30 fps with I- and P-frames only and one I-frame every 8 8 seconds. We then sample in the same units as training: each group consists of one RGB anchor followed by four predictive updates and does not cross an I-frame boundary. The number of groups adapts to video length, with at most 64 64 groups per video. For each predictive update we read the encoder’s motion vectors and resample them to a 24 × 24 24\times 24 macroblock grid (matching the 384 384 input resolution), and take the residual as the difference between the true target frame and its motion-compensated prediction, consistent with the definition of a codec P-frame. Each video therefore yields up to 64 64 I-frame anchors, and the four predictive updates of each group are read out as state readouts; the ablations in the main text either retain the I-frame tokens of only a subset of groups or drop the readouts entirely at evaluation time, without changing the underlying data.
blocks.zh: 我们把每个评价基准的原始视频转换成培训时使用的同一个编码表示:一个RGB主锚,连同其随后的预测框架的运动载体和剩余部分。 因此,这个帧索引的采样是决定性的,可以复制的,我们首先将每段视频重新编码为30英尺的固定结构,只有I-和P-帧,每8秒一个I-帧。 然后在训练的相同单位进行取样:每组由一个RGB锚地组成,然后进行四个预测更新,不跨越I-frame边界。 组数适应视频长度,每组最多64组. 对于每个预测更新,我们读取编码器的运动向量,并将其重新做成24×24 24\时的24宏块网格(匹配384 384输入分辨率),并将剩余值作为真实目标帧与其运动补偿预测的区别,与编码器P帧的定义一致. 因此,每段视频最多可产生64个I-frame主播,每个组的4个预测性更新作为状态读出;正文中的拼音要么只保留一组组的I-frame符号,要么在评价时完全放弃读出,而不改变基本数据.

blocks.en: A clip and its time reversal contain the same frames and the same average content; only the order in which changes were applied differs. Any representation that pools those frames symmetrically is invariant to the reversal by construction. Whether the discarded axis is empty in the frozen vision features that video language models actually use is a question that can be measured. We therefore build three parameter-free probes on the same frozen frame features, differing only in their symmetry over time. Let z 1 , … , z T z_{1},\ldots,z_{T} be uniformly sampled frame features and d t = z t + 1 − z t d_{t}=z_{t+1}-z_{t} the consecutive differences. The frame-symmetric probe takes the mean together with the two endpoints. Reversal only swaps the endpoints, the multiset of components is unchanged, and the score is identical. The difference-symmetric probe takes the mean, the standard deviation, and the maximum absolute value of the differences. The last two statistics are invariant to reversal. The mean obeys the telescoping identity mean ⁡ ( d ) = ( z T − z 1 ) / ( T − 1 ) \mathrm{mean}(d)=(z_{T}-z_{1})/(T-1) and only changes sign under reversal, so it carries net displacement rather than a path. The order-sensitive probe is a time-weighted sum of the differences, with weights given either by the time index, ∑ t t ​ d t \sum_{t}t\,d_{t} , or by an exponential in that index, ∑ t ( 0.8 ) t ​ d t \sum_{t}(0.8)^{t}d_{t} . Because the weights are tied to time, reversal changes the sum. A probe is scored by the mean, over its components, of its cosine similarity with a candidate vector. Nothing is trained, and the probes have no parameters. We use T ∈ { 8 , 16 } T\in\{8,16\} , and features from two frozen towers that differ in both architecture and training objective: a contrastively trained SigLIP tower ( Zhai et al., 2023 ) and the vision tower of Qwen2.5-VL ( Bai et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.en: Questions are split by the information they require, with 200 200 items in each bucket. The static bucket is drawn from the descriptive questions of NExT-QA ( Xiao et al., 2021 ) and the action questions of TempCompass ( Liu et al., 2024b ) ; the net-change bucket from temporal questions about a final state and from attribute-change questions; the order bucket from questions about which event came first. Order cannot be witnessed by question-answering rank. Swapping “ A A , and then B B ” with “ B B , and then A A ” leaves the two sentences at cosine 0.98 0.98 – 0.99 0.99 in pooled text space, against 0.58 0.58 – 0.72 0.72 for pairs that differ in content. The zero-shot text criterion is itself nearly order-blind, so no video-side probe can rank such options by it. Question-answering rank is therefore used only on the static and net-change buckets. Evidence that order is separable comes from the reversal axis: the same clip played forward and backward, and whether the probe’s decision changes. To compare the two towers without a shared text space, we also measure the displacement of the score vector against a fixed bank of random anchors.

blocks.en: Question-answering rank is readable only where the option text itself is separable. At T = 16 T{=}16 , scored against that text, the frame-symmetric probe reaches 0.685 0.685 on the static bucket, while the three difference probes score 0.195 0.195 , 0.265 0.265 , and 0.290 0.290 , level with a random probe at 0.200 0.200 . Differences discard static appearance beyond the endpoints. On the net-change bucket every probe scores between 0.335 0.335 and 0.365 0.365 , only slightly above the random probe at 0.290 0.290 , and no clean hierarchy appears. Ranking on the order bucket stays near that random floor, consistent with an order-blind text criterion, and is not offered as evidence about order.
blocks.zh: 只有在选项文本本身是可分开的时,才能读取问答的级别。 在T = 16 T Q = 16对准该文本时,帧对称探测器在静态桶上达到0.685 0.685,而三个差分探测器则得分0.195 0.195,0.265 0.265,0.290 0.290 0.290,以0.200 0.200 的随机探测器达到水平. 差异将静态外观丢弃于终点之外. 在净换桶上,每个探测器得分在0.335 0.335至0.365 0.365之间,仅略高于0.290 0.290的随机探测器,没有出现干净的等级. 命令桶上的排名停留在该随机层附近,符合命令盲文标准,不作为命令的证据。

blocks.en: Symmetric pooling therefore discards an axis that is not empty. In frozen visual features, a clip and its reverse are inseparable for the frame-symmetric probe, separable for an order-agnostic difference probe only through net displacement, and separable for a minimal order-sensitive probe. The same hierarchy recurs, at nearly the same values, on SigLIP and on Qwen2.5-VL, and is a property of frozen video representations rather than of one tower. Static appearance is carried by the endpoints and the mean. Order and content are different axes, not a refinement of one another.
blocks.zh: 因此,对称集合抛弃了一个不是空的轴. 在冷冻的视觉特征中,片段及其反面对于帧对称探测器是不可分的,只能通过净移位来分离命令-不可知差探测器,也可以分离到最小的对命令敏感的探测器. 同样的等级在SigLIP和Quen2.5-VL上以几乎相同的数值重现,是被冻结的视频表达而不是一个塔的财产. 静态外观由端点和平均值承载. 秩序和内容是不同的轴线,而不是彼此的完善.

blocks.en: Video language models encode sampled frames independently. When the number of frames is limited by the token budget, the changes between samples are dropped; pooling those frames symmetrically discards the order of the changes as well, by construction. This study shows that the discarded axis is non-empty in the feature spaces those models actually use, and that it can be read without training. What it supplies is the motivation for a stateful codec representation, not an ablation of one. A state updated in order applies the current observation to a reference it already carries, so order is preserved by construction and the readout stays in the space of visual features. The study trains no transition and compares no architecture. It only identifies the axis a representation has to keep.
blocks.zh: 视频语言模型独立编码样本帧. 当帧数受符号预算限制时,样本之间的变化就会被放弃;集合这些帧对称地丢弃变化的顺序,通过构造也丢弃. 这项研究显示,这些模型实际使用的特性空间中,被丢弃的轴是非空的,可以不经训练而读取. 它提供的东西是一种状态的解码表达的动机,而不是对一个的削弱. 为了将当前观测应用到它已经携带的参考物上而更新的状态,所以通过构造来维护秩序,读出会停留在视觉特征的空间中. 该研究没有进行过渡,也没有比较任何建筑. 它只确定一个代表必须保持的轴线。
